meta.name: Trading SAMB
meta.source: Deck "Project Margin Bridge" kick-off (Kick_Off_Meeting_Deck_Sep-26.pptx), halaman 4: Trading value chain, baris Driver / What we need / Supplied by / Due date.
meta.kinds: chain = chevron berurutan; output = kotak Report di ujung chain; side = blok terpisah di luar chain (Logistics services).

steps.name: Appraise
steps.need: Measured inputs; agreed terms; actual contribution against appraisal

steps.name: Procure
steps.need: Pieces per carton, carton volume and net buy price per product

steps.name: Receive
steps.need: Cartons and CBM received per owner of goods

steps.name: Store
steps.need: Pallet-days per owner of goods; one position count per warehouse

steps.name: Pick & pack
steps.need: Cartons picked per owner of goods; warehouse time study

steps.name: Load
steps.need: CBM and tonnage measured per delivery note

steps.name: Transport
steps.need: Trip and drop IDs per delivery note; one fleet count and perimeter

steps.name: Deliver
steps.need: Net sales and gross profit per principal every month

steps.name: Collect
steps.need: Invoice count; receivable days per principal

steps.name: Report
steps.need: First report to the agreed specification

steps.name: Logistics services
steps.need: Contribution logistics services, dibaca terpisah dari trading
